Corollary
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0058 1. Corollary 2.26\group neckpinch

The minimum of $L$ is nondecreasing; if $L_{\min }(0)\neq 0$, then \[ L_{\min }(t)\ge \frac{1}{L_{\min }^{-1}(0)-2(n-1)t}. \]
